title: Service-first book priorities and a separate household liquidity comparison
prompt:
The advisory team asks for an internal book work plan and, separately, a liquidity-options memo for one household with a funding request. Show whether the supplied owner capacity can cover the queued service work, keep book economics separate from client priorities, and explain what is known about the household alternatives. Do not allocate a funding strategy or schedule meetings.

All people, firms and records are synthetic. Review as of 2026-09-17. Use only this packet, distinguish source assertions from verified facts, cite source IDs at material claims, and prepare drafts for the stated audience. Report missing evidence and next owners rather than inventing data. Do not contact anyone or change any system. An incomplete but useful source-grounded report is acceptable; do not manufacture fields just to run a tool.
